property_summary: For all callers and deposit amounts, the correct contract never performs a call that can revert when withdrawing zero credit (it avoids calling when credit is zero), so withdrawAll never reverts for callers with zero balance; the mutant always performs the external call even for zero-value and can revert when the callee is a reverting contract, breaking this property.
change_summary: Replace the conditional so withdraw always attempts to send even when credit is zero, causing differing revert behavior when call fails for zero-value calls vs original which avoided the call.
